description: Team chat and collaboration platform with channels, DMs, and app integrations.
auth_method: OAuth2 (bot/user token scopes); legacy webhook/app-level tokens also supported
self_serve: self-serve free - anyone can create a free workspace and register a Slack app/bot without sales contact
api_surface: REST Web API (~200+ methods) plus Events API, Socket Mode, Block Kit; official remote MCP server (mcp.slack.com) and official npm MCP package
blocker: none significant; some scopes need workspace admin approval to install

description: Cloud communications platform providing programmable SMS, voice, video, and verification APIs.
auth_method: HTTP Basic auth (Account SID + Auth Token) or API Key SID+Secret
self_serve: self-serve free - free trial account with full API access, no card required
api_surface: REST, very broad (30+ products, ~1,800 endpoints); official self-hostable MCP server (twilio-labs/mcp)
blocker: trial accounts restricted to verified numbers until upgraded

description: Zoho's business team-chat app with channels, bots, and workflow integrations.
auth_method: OAuth2 (Zoho-oauthtoken bearer header, 1hr tokens with refresh)
self_serve: self-serve free - free plan, unlimited users, self-signup, no sales contact for dev credentials
api_surface: REST v2/v3, moderate breadth (messaging, bots, channels, webhooks); no known MCP server found
blocker: none major; smaller ecosystem than Slack

description: ByteDance's collaboration suite combining chat, docs, calendar, base with an open platform for bot/app integrations.
auth_method: App ID+Secret to obtain tenant/user access tokens (OAuth2-based)
self_serve: self-serve trial - free app registration on open.larksuite.com, but installing into a real tenant needs admin approval
api_surface: REST, very broad (Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail); official MCP server (larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp)
blocker: tenant admin approval needed to install/publish app; docs split across China/global versions

description: Free-tier-focused team chat app (CAKE.com) with channels, DMs, voice/video calling.
auth_method: API key (bearer/auth header, via API-keys addon)
self_serve: self-serve free - free Basic plan, unlimited users, API key addon self-installable
api_surface: REST (Swagger, addon-hosted), narrow (messages, reactions, users); no known MCP server
blocker: narrow API surface, addon-hosted docs rather than first-class dev portal

description: Voice, video, and text chat platform organized around servers and channels.
self_serve: self-serve free - free Developer Portal account, instant bot creation; privileged intents need review for large bots
api_surface: REST + Gateway WebSocket, broad; many community MCP servers, no single official Discord MCP server
blocker: privileged gateway intents need verification for bots in 100+ servers

description: Cloud-based messaging app with a widely used Bot API and MTProto client API.
auth_method: Bot token via @BotFather (Bot API) or MTProto session auth (client API)
self_serve: self-serve free - create a bot instantly via @BotFather, fully free
api_surface: HTTPS Bot API (broad) plus lower-level MTProto client API; multiple community MCP servers, no official one
blocker: MTProto user-account automation sits in ToS grey area

description: Meta's API platform for businesses to send/receive WhatsApp messages at scale via templates.
auth_method: OAuth2 / Meta system-user access tokens via Graph API
self_serve: admin/partner approval required - Meta Business Manager account, phone verification, business verification needed for production
api_surface: REST Graph API (Cloud API), broad; no dedicated official WhatsApp MCP server
blocker: business verification, template approval, per-message pricing add friction before production

description: Cloud-based phone system and call center software with call routing, IVR, CRM integrations.
self_serve: paid plan required - no free tier, API access typically on higher plans, OAuth apps need Aircall approval
api_surface: REST, moderate-to-broad (calls, contacts, numbers, users, webhooks); third-party MCP servers exist, no official one confirmed
blocker: no free tier; OAuth integrations require partner approval

description: CPaaS offering SMS, voice, video, verification, and messaging APIs including WhatsApp.
auth_method: API key/secret (REST) or JWT signed with private key (Voice/Video)
self_serve: self-serve trial - free developer account with trial credit, no card required
api_surface: REST, broad (SMS, Voice, Verify, Messages/WhatsApp); official Vonage MCP Tooling Server exists
blocker: WhatsApp channel inherits Meta's business-verification requirement
